# ATSCheck Resume Reviewer & ATS Keyword Matcher

> ATSCheck is a free browser-based resume reviewer and ATS keyword matcher engineered open-source by full-stack developer Arnav Singh. It checks common document structure and formatting signals, compares recognized job-description skill terms, and offers draft wording suggestions 100% privately in-browser.

## Creator & Engineering
- **Founder & Lead Developer**: Arnav Singh (Full-Stack Software Engineer)
- **Developer Profile & Mission**: https://atscheck.tech/about
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Arnav20007
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/Arnav20007/ats
- **Contact Email**: arnavsinghas1221@gmail.com

## Core Capabilities
- **Resume review**: Checks selected text, section labels, contact fields, formatting signals, and measurable achievement details.
- **Job-description comparison**: Compares recognized skill terms in a job description with text in the resume. Unsupported or unrecognized terms are not assessed.
- **Draft wording suggestions**: Helps users structure achievement bullets while leaving factual claims and metrics for the user to provide.
- **Browser-side document handling**: Resume text is processed in the browser and is not sent to ATSCheck application servers. The site loads fonts from Google Fonts; the optional UPI support dialog requests a QR image from qrserver.com.
